requests.prompt: Create a NEW genuine detailed 16-bit pixel-art SOURCE ATLAS. Use the attached art only as a character-design reference, not as frames to duplicate. All figures face screen right. Every figure is independently drawn with a distinct pose and the same body proportions. All full heads, full feet and full equipment must be completely visible with very wide transparent gutters between figures and a generous outer transparent border of at least 60 pixels. No figure or weapon may touch another cell or a canvas edge. Transparent background; no floor, shadow, grid, text, labels, scenery or other characters. Solo non-graphic animation acting, no victim, blood or injury. EXACTLY TWELVE separate full-body figures in FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS (4x3). Adult Valen the Betrayer, Doom Eternal 2020: brown-bronze Sentinel plate, fur collar, long dark hair and beard, physical two-handed Sentinel axe, as attached. ROW1 four MATCH VICTORY poses: restrained calm personal acknowledgment with axe held safely near body, no attack. ROW2 four SUPER poses: brace, prepare a short close-stance physical axe cut, execute the compact cut at pose3, recover. Keep the axe steeply diagonal close to torso; no wide horizontal or overhead sweep, no axe-tip extension beyond its own cell. ROW3 four HIT REACTION poses: guarded protective recoil and recovery, axe retained safely. No arcs, trails, dust, energy, glow or detached particles anywhere. Exactly four complete figures in every row, three rows, twelve total.
